visualCharacteristics.structure: full-bleed poster picture + muted looping background video with play/pause toggle; color bar on the page color with a curved top, color name (h1) + color code and a round add-to-project button
visualCharacteristics.layout: media fills the viewport above the bar; bar: name + code centered, round '+' button left (tablet+) or full-width below (mobile). Overlay option moves the title group over the media

contentPattern: Rows: [picture (poster) + p > a (MP4 URL)] / [h1 color name] / [optional eyebrow text]. Rows are found by shape: missing video falls back to the poster, missing h1 falls back to color-name metadata. Reads color-code, color-name, rgbhex metadata.
